settingsSaveFailed.message: Settings could not be saved. Reopen the extension and try again.

extDesc.message: Bilingual subtitles for YouTube — original and translation in one non-overlapping layer.

targetCustomPlaceholder.message: For example: nl, tr, uk, pt-BR

targetCustomHint.message: Enter a code for a language outside this list. Availability depends on captions and translation services.

targetCustomInvalid.message: Enter a valid language code, such as nl, tr, or pt-BR.

targetCustomSaveFailed.message: Could not save the target language. Try again.

backendTipHtml.message:
Whole-sentence: prefers YouTube's aligned translation; after a 0.35s wait, Google translates the current and next two sentences.
Per-sentence: sends sentences to Google's free endpoint.
Fast display: starts Google for the current and next two sentences immediately while YouTube loads. Native caption preview can also use Google before the track arrives. Google may be rate-limited.

posHint.message: Tip: you can also drag the subtitle box on the video

widthHint.message: Drag either side of the subtitle box. Double-click a side grip to restore the default width.

resizeLeft.message: Drag the left edge to resize; double-click to reset width

resizeRight.message: Drag the right edge to resize; double-click to reset width

offsetHint.message: Subtitles too early? move right. Too late? move left.

repeatHint.message: Rewinds to the start of each sentence so you can shadow it

revealHint.message: Listen first; show the translation only when you need it

karaokeHint.message: Prefer original word timings; otherwise try matching a same-language automatic track. The full sentence stays visible.

timingModeAuto.message: Automatic: reliable times first, estimated for the rest

timingModeApproximate.message: Approximate follow-along: no automatic-caption fetch, no audio model

timingModeAudio.message: Audio alignment: analyse the audio with the local model

timingModeHint.message: The mode fully applies the next time a video or subtitle track loads; audio alignment also needs the local helper.

karaokeApproximateLabel.message: Use approximate progress when word times are missing

karaokeApproximateHint.message: Estimated from syllables, punctuation and this speaker's pace, and labeled Approximate in the video. Turn off to use reliable caption word times only.

karaokeStatusCaptions.message: Word highlighting: original caption word times

karaokeStatusAutomatic.message: Word highlighting: matched same-language automatic caption times

karaokeStatusAutomaticPartial.message: Word highlighting: some words matched the automatic captions, the rest is estimated

karaokeStatusEstimated.message: Approximate progress: syllables, punctuation and this speaker's pace, not precise audio alignment

karaokeStatusUnavailable.message: No reliable word times for this sentence. Showing the complete sentence.

karaokeStatusWaiting.message: Word highlighting: waiting for timed original captions

karaokeStyleHint.message: Higher opacity hides more of the video behind the highlight. At 100%, the background is fully opaque.

wordLookupLabel.message: Look up words by hovering over original captions

wordLookupHint.message: Pause over a word for a translation. German words have a link to the German Assistant dictionary.

studyKeyHint.message: Shortcuts: Alt+Shift+S repeat this sentence · Alt+Shift+U show/hide translation

liveHint.message: Works on YouTube video pages only. Mid-sentence, "previous" first jumps back to the start of that sentence.

liveNotYoutube.message: Use this on a YouTube video page.

liveNoCue.message: This video has no captions yet — play a few seconds, or try another video.

liveFailed.message: That did nothing — refresh the page and try again.

autoCaptionsLabel.message: Turn YouTube captions on for me

autoCaptionsHint.message: Off = you use the player's own caption button; the overlay still renders on top

shortcutHint.message: The browser only lets its own page change keys

shortcutManual.message: Open this in the address bar:

statusNoReply.message: No page status yet — if this is a YouTube video page, refresh it once.

statusOff.message: Extension is off — no subtitles are shown.

statusScrape.message: Source: on-screen captions (immediate preview / track loading)

statusIdle.message: Waiting for captions — check YouTube's CC switch and selected track

sizeHint.message: Smaller players shrink captions and leave room for controls. Fullscreen uses this size, with long captions reduced to fit.

revealShortcut.message: Show or hide the translation line

handleTitle.message: Drag to move · double-click to reset

handleAria.message: Drag to move subtitles, double-click to reset

exportNoTrans.message: No translation available for this video — try the Whole-sentence engine or another target language.

exportNoCues.message: No downloadable subtitles — play a few seconds so captions load, then try again.

exportNotYoutube.message: Open a YouTube video page to export.

exportFailed.message: Export failed — refresh the page and try again.

exportPartial.message: Translation is incomplete; export stopped to avoid mismatched lines.

studyTrackHint.message: Select the original caption track in the video player; set the translation language in the extension popup.

studyLibraryFull.message: Your saved list is full. Remove an item before saving more.

studySavedDone.message: Saved for later listening and review.

studyNoSentence.message: No sentence is active. Play a captioned video first.

studyStoreFailed.message: Could not save. Check browser storage and try again.

studySeekFailed.message: Could not jump. Refresh the video and try again.

studyNoTranscript.message: No sentence track yet. Play a captioned video for a few seconds.

studyPresetDone.message: Study preset enabled. Your target language is unchanged; confirm the original caption track.

studyImportTooLarge.message: Backup file is too large; import stopped.

studyImportInvalid.message: This is not a valid saved-sentence backup.

studyImportFull.message: Import would exceed the saved-sentence limit; existing data is unchanged.

audioOpenHint.message: Fill missing word times using a local audio model; first use needs model setup.

karaokeStatusAudioFailed.message: Audio alignment failed. Check that the local helper is running, then align again.

karaokeStatusAudioStale.message: The saved audio alignment does not match the current subtitles, so it is ignored. Align again to use it.

audioIntro.message: Align original captions with audio while keeping the full sentence visible. German and English models run locally.

audioSourceHint.message: Analyze the current position first. First use downloads a model of about 360 MB; models and word times are cached. Playback can continue during analysis.

audioLocalHint.message: The file must match this video. If it starts partway through, enter the video time it begins at below; a file that does not cover the subtitles is reported instead of being applied with wrong times.

audioOffset.message: Start time of the local file in seconds (0 for a complete file from 0:00)

audioTooShort.message: The local audio is shorter than the subtitles, so nothing was applied. Use a complete file or enter its correct start time.

audioMismatch.message: The local audio does not overlap this video's subtitles. Check that the file belongs to this video and enter its start time.

audioLengthDetail.message: Audio reaches $1 s, subtitles reach $2 s.

audioStaleCache.message: The alignment saved for this video belongs to different subtitles. Run the analysis again for the current track.

audioSubtitlesChanged.message: The subtitle track changed, so the analysis stopped. Results stay saved for the original track.

audioVideoChanged.message: Another video started, so the analysis stopped. Nothing from the previous video is applied here.

audioSetupHint.message: In the extension folder, double-click tools → Start-AudioAlignment.cmd. It prepares a separate Python environment and starts the local helper. Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg are required. Return here after setup.

audioPrivacy.message: This feature connects only to 127.0.0.1. Captions and audio are processed locally. The helper downloads public audio from YouTube and models from Hugging Face; browser login data is not read.

audioAccuracy.message: Alignment may contain errors. Unsupported numbers, mismatched text and low-confidence sentences keep their existing mode. Keep this page open for new results; saved results survive a video refresh.

audioNoCues.message: No full original captions are available. Refresh the video after updating the extension, enable captions, and reopen this page.

audioAlreadyTimed.message: These sentences already have word times. No audio analysis is needed.

audioModel.message: Preparing the speech model; the first download may take several minutes…

audioDelivered.message: New results have been applied to the video.

audioVideoChanged.message: The video or track changed. Results are saved locally for the original video.

audioNoMatches.message: No reliable word alignment was found. Check that the audio and captions match; existing subtitles remain usable.

audioOffline.message: The local helper is not connected. Start tools/Start-AudioAlignment.cmd in the extension folder, then retry.

audioYoutubeFailed.message: YouTube did not provide anonymous audio. Choose a matching local audio or video file.

audioUnsupported.message: Audio alignment currently supports German and English.

audioFfmpegMissing.message: FFmpeg was not found. Install it or set YTDS_FFMPEG to its executable path, then restart the helper.

audioInvalid.message: The selected audio could not be decoded. Try another matching file.

audioTooLong.message: The media is too large or too long (maximum 512 MiB / 6 hours).

audioBusy.message: The local helper is busy. Stop an existing job or wait for it to finish.

audioInvalidRequest.message: The captions cannot be analyzed as supplied. Try a shorter captioned video.

audioJobLost.message: The helper restarted. Start the analysis again; completed cached results can be reused.

audioHelperOld.message: The local helper is older than this extension build, so it cannot produce track-locked word times. Restart it from tools/Start-AudioAlignment.cmd, then retry.

audioPermissionDenied.message: Local site access was not granted. Start again and allow access to 127.0.0.1.

audioFailed.message: Audio analysis did not finish. Check the helper and model download, then retry. Existing subtitles remain usable.

bbEnableHint.message: Only affects Bilibili, not YouTube. You can also toggle subtitles with the icon in the player's bottom control bar.

bbSiteHint.message: Chinese original with the German translation above it. Live streams, bangumi and the mobile site are not supported.

bbTrackHint.message: The choice applies to the current video part only.

bbUnsupportedPage.message: This is not a normal Bilibili video page.

bbNeedLogin.message: Bilibili only exposes this video's captions to a signed-in viewer. Sign in and reload the page.

bbNoTrack.message: This video has no Chinese caption track. You can import an SRT file instead.

bbNotChinese.message: This video has captions, but none of them is Chinese.

bbFetchFailed.message: The Chinese captions could not be loaded.

bbImportMissing.message: No imported subtitle file is bound to this video part.

statusNoReplyAny.message: No page status yet — if this is a YouTube or Bilibili video page, refresh it once.

statusIdleBili.message: Waiting for a Bilibili Chinese caption track — switch the track below or import an SRT

bbImportHint.message: Bound to this video and part only, kept on this machine, never uploaded. Its text is sent to the translation service when translating.

bbImportActive.message: Subtitles come from the imported file

bbImportUnreadable.message: That file could not be read.

bbImportCleared.message: The local subtitle file was unbound.

bbRecognizedActive.message: Subtitles come from on-device speech recognition

recogHint.message: Generates subtitles for videos that have none. Audio goes only to the Deutsch Overlay running on this computer; nothing is uploaded.

recogBaseHint.message: Run deutsch-overlay-bridge on the desktop, then copy the address and token it prints into the fields below.

recogCaptureHint.message: Available only once the current video is confirmed to have no caption track. The video stays audible while recognizing.

recogNoPage.message: No page status received — reload the video page.

recogHasCaptions.message: This video already has a caption track; recognition is not needed.

recogUnknownCaptions.message: It is not confirmed yet whether this video has a caption track. Play a few seconds or switch a caption track first.

recogNotConfigured.message: Fill in the local service address and token first.

recogReady.message: Ready: this video has no caption track.

recogOtherTab.message: Another tab is being recognized. Stop it there first.

recogTokenLocal.message: The token stays in this browser and is never synced; resetting settings clears it.

recogPermissionRequired.message: Allow access to the local service address first.

recogInvalidBase.message: The local service address is invalid.

recogOffline.message: The local service is not running or cannot be reached.

recogUnauthorized.message: The token was rejected; copy it again from the local service.

recogBadResponse.message: The local service returned an unrecognized response.

recogCheckFirst.message: Check the connection before starting recognition.

recogModelNotReady.message: model will load when recognition starts

recogTokenUnchecked.message: the token is verified when recognition starts

studyAnkiDone.message: Anki file downloaded; import it in Anki and map the columns by their headers.

karaokeStatusRecognition.message: Karaoke: speech recognition word times; errors are possible

recogOptionsHint.message: Load settings after checking the connection. Terms stay on this device; settings last for this bridge run. Stop recognition before changing them.

recogSentenceContext.message: Translate adjacent fragments as a whole sentence (optional)

recogOptionsBusy.message: Stop recognition in all tabs before changing settings.

recogOptionsFailed.message: Settings were not updated. Check the connection, token and bridge version.

recogOptionsLoaded.message: Loaded. You can leave terminology empty.

recogEditHint.message: Corrections last until this page closes. Save or export them to keep them; changing text clears old word timings. Raw recognition:

recogEditFailed.message: Captions changed or text is invalid. Reload the list.

recogRetryQueued.message: Recognition was queued again. Reload the transcript shortly.

recogRetryExpired.message: The segment expired or recognition stopped. Replay it and restart recognition.

recogDeviceUnloaded.message: Not loaded; loaded when recognition starts

recogInputSignal.message: Audio input: signal received (not proof of speech)

recogInputSilent.message: Audio input: sustained silence or very low signal; may be a pause or capture issue

recogInputMissing.message: Audio input: no capture data; stop and start again

recogInputSuspended.message: Audio input: processing suspended; stop and start again

recogInputMediaWaiting.message: Audio input: waiting for video position

recogCaptureEnded.message: Tab audio capture ended; displayed captions remain. You can start again.

recogTranslationTarget.message: Local recognition uses German as an intermediate line; other display targets are translated afterward.
